title: Source-bound sensor-depth compartment selection for TCS7/TCS8

equations: select nodsen=i at the first node whose bottom is not above the tolerated sensor depth

scope: pure bounded search over supplied monotonically ordered compartment bottoms
non_goals: soil-grid construction, coordinate conversion, sensor-depth parsing or profile validation
hydraulic state access, TCS7/TCS8 threshold evaluation or event selection
out-of-profile legacy behavior, accepted mass, restart or production admission
pass_conditions: all valid in-profile node indices match the B1.11 search exactly
100000 deterministic profiles pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
